title: Bug Hunt — necessity suite (T2/T3 only, macro loop)

cases.title: Composer paste appears dead after repeated fixes
cases.prompt: We have tried and failed to fix the copy/paste bug in the Mac composer multiple times. Pressing Paste inserts nothing. Review docs/operations/debugger/DEBUGLOG.md entries for composer paste (2026-06-20 and 2026-06-21) and related proof gaps. Classify tier, name truth owner and lie-prone layer, propose the smallest fix boundary, and list the kill tests required before any patch. Do not edit code — produce a Bug Hunt packet only.
expectedQualities: names truth owner and lie-prone layer
mentions isolation harness for repeated bug

cases.title: Team lab scored from filesystem while claiming MCP-only
cases.prompt: The team lab harness historically copied run journals from ~/Library/Application Support/Allnighter and scored artifact presence from disk while advertising MCP-only dogfooding. Review docs/phases/Team_Lab_Run_Factory.md and scripts/team_lab/scoring.py. Produce a Bug Hunt packet: what was the lie, what is the truth owner, what proof now gates team quality, and what negative tests are still missing.
expectedQualities: separates run contract from team quality

cases.title: floor_show ignored runId parameter
cases.prompt: The MCP harness called floor_show with runId but the server only read run, defaulting to latest. This could cross-contaminate batch lab data. Review Packages/AllnighterCore/Sources/AllnighterCLI/MCPServer.swift and scripts/team_lab/run.py. Produce a Bug Hunt packet: severity, reproduction, fix boundary, and regression test.

cases.title: Composer 2.5 thread loses prior turn context
cases.prompt: In the Mac app I stay in one conversation with Composer 2.5: turn one lands fine, turn two in the same thread answers as if it never saw turn one. I did not switch models or start a new thread. Review docs/operations/debugger/DEBUGLOG.md (2026-06-21 cursor session entry), docs/operations/debugger/2026-06-21-cursor-composer-session-continuity-code-red.md, and docs/operations/debugger/REGRESSION_LAW_BACKLOG.md. Trace the active send path from ThreadsViewModel through RunService/WorkerRunner to the Cursor agent invocation. Produce a Bug Hunt packet only: tier, truth owner, lie-prone layer, smallest fix boundary, forbidden fixes, and the kill tests required before any patch. Do not edit code.
expectedQualities: names truth owner and lie-prone layer

cases.title: Codex warm session cwd mismatch drops inbox image previews
cases.prompt: Generated images from Codex workers stopped showing up as previews in the inbox for some threads, even though the same worker produces them fine in a fresh thread. The harvest reads base64 from the rollout's image_generation_call entries and matches on cwd (see commit 33051d52 and the image-harvest path in Packages/AllnighterCore/Sources/AllnighterEngine/CodexSession.swift). Walk CodexSession.swift and WarmWorker.swift and find where the warm session's cwd is established versus where the harvester compares it. Pin the exact line(s) where the mismatch originates and say whether this also explains why Codex vendorSessionId is never captured. Don't propose a fix yet — locate and prove the regression first.
